The backend stores the change and the frontend shows the new status only after the backend confirms it.","business_value":"Users can see which tasks are finished and which are still open.","acceptance_criteria":[{"given":"a task with status Open exists","when":"the user marks the task as Completed","then":"the backend stores the status Completed and the task list shows the task with status Completed"},{"given":"the status change request for an existing task fails in the backend","when":"the frontend receives the failure","then":"the task list still shows the previous status and an error message is displayed"},{"given":"a status change request is pending and the backend has not responded yet","when":"the task list is displayed","then":"the row still shows the previous status and no success message is displayed"},{"given":"a status change request is sent for a task ID that does not exist","when":"the backend processes the request","then":"the backend returns a task not found error and no stored task changes"},{"given":"a status change request is sent with a status value other than Completed (including Open, In Progress, or any value outside Open, In Progress, Completed)","when":"the backend validates the request","then":"the backend rejects the request with an invalid input error and the stored status does not change"},{"given":"a task is marked as Completed","when":"the backend saves the change","then":"the Completion Date field of the task is populated with the time of the change"}],"edge_cases":["The PRD does not state which status transitions are allowed beyond marking a task as Completed;
